lines.text: The AP Framework is a summary of the philosophy of Acharya Prashant, an Indian teacher of Vedanta.
lines.ph: ðɪ ˌeɪpˈiː fɹˈeɪmwɜːk ɪz ɐ sˈʌmɚɹi ʌvðə fɪlˈɑːsəfi ʌv ˈɑːtʃɑːɹjə pɹəʃˈɑːnt, ɐn ˈɪndiən tˈiːtʃɚɹ ʌv veɪdˈɑːntə.

lines.text: It covers seven questions: what is real, how we know, what liberation is, what has value, what the mind is, what a human being is, and what art is.
lines.ph: ɪt kˈʌvɚz sˈɛvən kwˈɛstʃənz: wˌʌt ɪz ɹˈiːəl, hˌaʊ wiː nˈoʊ, wˌʌt lˌɪbɚɹˈeɪʃən ɪz, wˌʌt hɐz vˈæljuː, wˌʌt ðə mˈaɪnd ɪz, wˌʌt ɐ hjˈuːmən bˈiːɪŋ ɪz, ænd wʌt ˈɑːɹt ɪz.

lines.text: But it does not ask you to believe anything.
lines.ph: bˌʌt ɪt dʌznˌɑːt ˈæsk juː tə bᵻlˈiːv ˈɛnɪθˌɪŋ.

lines.text: It calls itself a set of diagnostic tools: ways of catching a mistake while you are making it.
lines.ph: ɪt kˈɔːlz ɪtsˈɛlf ɐ sˈɛt ʌv dˌaɪəɡnˈɑːstɪk tˈuːlz: wˈeɪz ʌv kˈætʃɪŋ ɐ mɪstˈeɪk wˌaɪl juː ɑːɹ mˈeɪkɪŋ ɪt.

lines.text: And the mistake it is looking for has a name: the ego.
lines.ph: ænd ðə mɪstˈeɪk ɪɾ ɪz lˈʊkɪŋ fɔːɹ hɐz ɐ nˈeɪm: ðɪ ˈiːɡoʊ.

lines.text: Start with something everyone knows: dissatisfaction.
lines.ph: stˈɑːɹt wɪð sˈʌmθɪŋ ˈɛvɹɪwˌʌn nˈoʊz: dɪsˌæɾɪsfˈækʃən.

lines.text: We change jobs, cities, partners and plans, and after a while the old ache comes back.
lines.ph: wiː tʃˈeɪndʒ dʒˈɑːbz, sˈɪɾiz, pˈɑːɹtnɚz ænd plˈænz, ænd ˈæftɚɹ ɐ wˈaɪl ðɪ ˈoʊld ˈeɪk kˈʌmz bˈæk.

lines.text: The framework says this ache is structural, not circumstantial. It is not about where you are.
lines.ph: ðə fɹˈeɪmwɜːk sˈɛz ðɪs ˈeɪk ɪz stɹˈʌktʃɚɹəl, nˌɑːt sˈɜːkəmstˌænʃəl. ɪɾ ɪz nˌɑːt ɐbˌaʊt wˈɛɹ juː ɑːɹ.

lines.text: So the real question is not whether we are trying hard enough.
lines.ph: sˌoʊ ðə ɹˈiːəl kwˈɛstʃən ɪz nˌɑːt wˈɛðɚ wiː ɑːɹ tɹˈaɪɪŋ hˈɑːɹd ɪnˈʌf.

lines.text: It is whether the whole direction of our effort is wrong.
lines.ph: ɪɾ ɪz wˈɛðɚ ðə hˈoʊl dᵻɹˈɛkʃən ʌv ˌaʊɚɹ ˈɛfɚt ɪz ɹˈɔŋ.

lines.text: The ego, in this framework, is simply the felt sense of I am X.
lines.ph: ðɪ ˈiːɡoʊ, ɪn ðɪs fɹˈeɪmwɜːk, ɪz sˈɪmpli ðə fˈɛlt sˈɛns ʌv aɪɐm ˈɛks.

lines.text: Its roots are physical. The skin marks where the body ends and the world begins, and a separate, bounded self grows from that line.
lines.ph: ɪts ɹˈuːts ɑːɹ fˈɪzɪkəl. ðə skˈɪn mˈɑːɹks wˌɛɹ ðə bˈɑːdi ˈɛndz ænd ðə wˈɜːld bɪɡˈɪnz, ænd ɐ sˈɛpɹət, bˈaʊndᵻd sˈɛlf ɡɹˈoʊz fɹʌm ðæt lˈaɪn.

lines.text: A bounded self feels incomplete, so it reaches out and takes things in: my house, my country, my degrees, even my wounds.
lines.ph: ɐ bˈaʊndᵻd sˈɛlf fˈiːlz ɪŋkəmplˈiːt, sˌoʊ ɪt ɹˈiːtʃᵻz ˈaʊt ænd tˈeɪks θˈɪŋz ˈɪn: maɪ hˈaʊs, maɪ kˈʌntɹi, maɪ dᵻɡɹˈiːz, ˈiːvən maɪ wˈuːndz.

lines.text: Every possession, title and grievance makes it heavier. The framework calls this ego fattening.
lines.ph: ˈɛvɹi pəzˈɛʃən, tˈaɪɾəl ænd ɡɹˈiːvəns mˌeɪks ɪt hˈɛviɚ. ðə fɹˈeɪmwɜːk kˈɔːlz ðɪs ˈiːɡoʊ fˈæʔn̩ɪŋ.

lines.text: The opposite, ego thinning, is a slow loss of that weight and self-concern.
lines.ph: ðɪ ˈɑːpəzˌɪt, ˈiːɡoʊ θˈɪnɪŋ, ɪz ɐ slˈoʊ lˈɔs ʌv ðæt wˈeɪt ænd sˈɛlfkənsˈɜːn.

lines.text: It never reaches zero while the body lives. Some ego always remains; the framework calls it the ego floor.
lines.ph: ɪt nˈɛvɚ ɹˈiːtʃᵻz zˈiəɹoʊ wˌaɪl ðə bˈɑːdi lˈaɪvz. sˌʌm ˈiːɡoʊ ˈɔːlweɪz ɹᵻmˈeɪnz; ðə fɹˈeɪmwɜːk kˈɔːlz ɪt ðɪ ˈiːɡoʊ flˈoːɹ.

lines.text: The ego also uses the body. Try reading a difficult book that threatens your opinions, and notice how quickly you feel sleepy.
lines.ph: ðɪ ˈiːɡoʊ ˈɔːlsoʊ jˈuːsᵻz ðə bˈɑːdi. tɹˈaɪ ɹˈiːdɪŋ ɐ dˈɪfɪkəlt bˈʊk ðæt θɹˈɛʔn̩z jʊɹ əpˈɪniənz, ænd nˈoʊɾɪs hˌaʊ kwˈɪkli juː fˈiːl slˈiːpi.

lines.text: That drowsiness is not just tiredness. The ego is using the body to escape.
lines.ph: ðæt dɹˈaʊsinəs ɪz nˌɑːt dʒˈʌst tˈaɪɚdnəs. ðɪ ˈiːɡoʊ ɪz jˈuːzɪŋ ðə bˈɑːdi tʊ ɛskˈeɪp.

lines.text: The mind, memory and intellect, is called an innocent machine. It does what it is told.
lines.ph: ðə mˈaɪnd, mˈɛmɚɹi ænd ˈɪntəlˌɛkt, ɪz kˈɔːld ɐn ˈɪnəsənt məʃˈiːn. ɪt dˈʌz wʌt ɪɾ ɪz tˈoʊld.

lines.text: Only the ego has agency. It is the senior partner.
lines.ph: ˈoʊnli ðɪ ˈiːɡoʊ hɐz ˈeɪdʒənsi. ɪɾ ɪz ðə sˈiːnjɚ pˈɑːɹtnɚ.

lines.text: So when there is suffering, the framework says, blame the right party: not the mind, but the ego that is driving it.
lines.ph: sˌoʊ wɛn ðɛɹ ɪz sˈʌfɚɹɪŋ, ðə fɹˈeɪmwɜːk sˈɛz, blˈeɪm ðə ɹˈaɪt pˈɑːɹɾi: nˌɑːt ðə mˈaɪnd, bˌʌt ðɪ ˈiːɡoʊ ðæt ɪz dɹˈaɪvɪŋ ɪt.

lines.text: All movement, the framework says, goes in one of two directions.
lines.ph: ˈɔːl mˈuːvmənt, ðə fɹˈeɪmwɜːk sˈɛz, ɡoʊz ɪn wˈʌn ʌv tˈuː dᵻɹˈɛkʃənz.

lines.text: The horizontal is change: gaining, achieving, collecting. A shopkeeper expands his business. A student collects degrees. A pilgrim multiplies his penances.
lines.ph: ðə hˌɔːɹɪzˈɔntəl ɪz tʃˈeɪndʒ: ɡˈeɪnɪŋ, ɐtʃˈiːvɪŋ, kəlˈɛktɪŋ. ɐ ʃˈɑːpkiːpɚɹ ɛkspˈændz hɪz bˈɪznəs. ɐ stˈuːdənt kəlˈɛkts dᵻɡɹˈiːz. ɐ pˈɪlɡɹɪm mˌʌltɪplˈaɪz hɪz pˈɛnənsᵻz.

lines.text: Energy is spent and things change, but no height is gained. Everyone is moving on the same flat sheet.
lines.ph: ˈɛnɚdʒi ɪz spˈɛnt ænd θˈɪŋz tʃˈeɪndʒ, bˌʌt nˈoʊ hˈaɪt ɪz ɡˈeɪnd. ˈɛvɹɪwˌʌn ɪz mˈuːvɪŋ ɔnðə sˈeɪm flˈæt ʃˈiːt.

lines.text: The vertical is freedom. It is not about having more, but about the centre you act from becoming thinner.
lines.ph: ðə vˈɜːɾɪkəl ɪz fɹˈiːdəm. ɪɾ ɪz nˌɑːt ɐbˌaʊt hˌævɪŋ mˈoːɹ, bˌʌt ɐbˌaʊt ðə sˈɛntɚ juː ˈækt fɹʌm bᵻkˈʌmɪŋ θˈɪnɚ.

lines.text: The belief that enough horizontal effort will lift you vertically, the framework calls the biggest lie.
lines.ph: ðə bᵻlˈiːf ðæt ɪnˈʌf hˌɔːɹɪzˈɔntəl ˈɛfɚt wɪl lˈɪft juː vˈɜːɾɪkli, ðə fɹˈeɪmwɜːk kˈɔːlz ðə bˈɪɡɪst lˈaɪ.

lines.text: Picture the ego as an engine. Desire is the fuel; action is the combustion.
lines.ph: pˈɪktʃɚ ðɪ ˈiːɡoʊ æz ɐn ˈɛndʒɪn. dɪzˈaɪɚɹ ɪz ðə fjˈuːəl; ˈækʃən ɪz ðə kəmbˈʌstʃən.

lines.text: The achiever's engine roars. He is always going somewhere.
lines.ph: ðɪ ɐtʃˈiːvɚz ˈɛndʒɪn ɹˈoːɹz. hiː ɪz ˈɔːlweɪz ɡˌoʊɪŋ sˈʌmwɛɹ.

lines.text: The dropout has given up. His stillness looks like peace, but the tank has simply run out.
lines.ph: ðə dɹˈɑːpaʊt hɐz ɡˈɪvən ˈʌp. hɪz stˈɪlnəs lˈʊks lˈaɪk pˈiːs, bˌʌt ðə tˈæŋk hɐz sˈɪmpli ɹˈʌn ˈaʊt.

lines.text: Refuel him with a new hope, and the old engine roars back.
lines.ph: ɹᵻfjˈuːl hˌɪm wɪð ɐ nˈuː hˈoʊp, ænd ðɪ ˈoʊld ˈɛndʒɪn ɹˈoːɹz bˈæk.

lines.text: Achiever and dropout stand on the same flat sheet. Losing desire is not the same as being free.
lines.ph: ɐtʃˈiːvɚɹ ænd dɹˈɑːpaʊt stˈænd ɔnðə sˈeɪm flˈæt ʃˈiːt. lˈuːzɪŋ dɪzˈaɪɚɹ ɪz nˌɑːt ðə sˈeɪm æz bˌiːɪŋ fɹˈiː.

lines.text: So what does change? The framework gives a formula.
lines.ph: sˌoʊ wʌt dˈʌz tʃˈeɪndʒ? ðə fɹˈeɪmwɜːk ɡˈɪvz ɐ fˈɔːɹmjʊlə.

lines.text: Change equals seeing plus intent.
lines.ph: tʃˈeɪndʒ ˈiːkwəlz sˈiːɪŋ plˈʌs ɪntˈɛnt.

lines.text: Seeing is honest observation of what is happening, before the ego adds its commentary and excuses.
lines.ph: sˈiːɪŋ ɪz ˈɑːnɪst ɑːbzɚvˈeɪʃən ʌv wʌt ɪz hˈæpənɪŋ, bᵻfˌoːɹ ðɪ ˈiːɡoʊ ˈædz ɪts kˈɑːməntˌɛɹi ænd ɛkskjˈuːsᵻz.

lines.text: Intent is the continuing choice to let the ego dissolve rather than protect it.
lines.ph: ɪntˈɛnt ɪz ðə kəntˈɪnjuːɪŋ tʃˈɔɪs tə lˈɛt ðɪ ˈiːɡoʊ dɪsˈɑːlv ɹˈæðɚ ðɐn pɹətˈɛkt ɪt.

lines.text: Neither works alone. Seeing without intent, it argues against Krishnamurti, changes nothing.
lines.ph: nˈiːðɚ wˈɜːks ɐlˈoʊn. sˈiːɪŋ wɪðˌaʊt ɪntˈɛnt, ɪɾ ˈɑːɹɡjuːz ɐɡˈɛnst kɹˌɪʃnəmˈʊɹti, tʃˈeɪndʒᵻz nˈʌθɪŋ.

lines.text: And intent is not willpower. Willpower fights an outside enemy, a habit or a craving, and leaves the ego in charge.
lines.ph: ænd ɪntˈɛnt ɪz nˌɑːt wˈɪlpaʊɚ. wˈɪlpaʊɚ fˈaɪts ɐn aʊtsˈaɪd ˈɛnəmi, ɐ hˈæbɪt ɔːɹ ɐ kɹˈeɪvɪŋ, ænd lˈiːvz ðɪ ˈiːɡoʊ ɪn tʃˈɑːɹdʒ.

lines.text: Intent turns against the ego's own wish to survive. That, the framework says, is the real battle.
lines.ph: ɪntˈɛnt tˈɜːnz ɐɡˈɛnst ðɪ ˈiːɡoʊz ˈoʊn wˈɪʃ tə sɚvˈaɪv. ðˈæt, ðə fɹˈeɪmwɜːk sˈɛz, ɪz ðə ɹˈiːəl bˈæɾəl.

lines.text: The ego also keeps a ledger: a running account of what it is owed. The gifts it gave, the hurts it suffered, the sacrifices it made.
lines.ph: ðɪ ˈiːɡoʊ ˈɔːlsoʊ kˈiːps ɐ lˈɛdʒɚ: ɐ ɹˈʌnɪŋ ɐkˈaʊnt ʌv wʌt ɪɾ ɪz ˈoʊd. ðə ɡˈɪfts ɪt ɡˈeɪv, ðə hˈɜːts ɪt sˈʌfɚd, ðə sˈækɹᵻfˌaɪsᵻz ɪt mˈeɪd.

lines.text: While the ledger stays open, resentment has a purpose. The suffering is kept as proof of a claim.
lines.ph: wˌaɪl ðə lˈɛdʒɚ stˈeɪz ˈoʊpən, ɹᵻzˈɛntmənt hɐz ɐ pˈɜːpəs. ðə sˈʌfɚɹɪŋ ɪz kˈɛpt æz pɹˈuːf əvə klˈeɪm.

lines.text: Take a frozen shoulder. In one case the arm could move, but does not; the stiffness is a strategy, and the ledger stays open.
lines.ph: tˈeɪk ɐ fɹˈoʊzən ʃˈoʊldɚ. ɪn wˈʌn kˈeɪs ðɪ ˈɑːɹm kʊd mˈuːv, bˌʌt dʌznˈɑːt; ðə stˈɪfnəs ɪz ɐ stɹˈæɾədʒi, ænd ðə lˈɛdʒɚ stˈeɪz ˈoʊpən.

lines.text: In the other, the joint is truly damaged, and exercise alone will not help.
lines.ph: ɪnðɪ ˈʌðɚ, ðə dʒˈɔɪnt ɪz tɹˈuːli dˈæmɪdʒd, ænd ˈɛksɚsˌaɪz ɐlˈoʊn wɪl nˌɑːt hˈɛlp.

lines.text: Even then, one choice remains: to go and find a surgeon.
lines.ph: ˈiːvən ðˈɛn, wˈʌn tʃˈɔɪs ɹᵻmˈeɪnz: tə ɡˌoʊ ænd fˈaɪnd ɐ sˈɜːdʒən.

lines.text: Two people weep at the same piece of music. From outside, they look the same.
lines.ph: tˈuː pˈiːpəl wˈiːp æt ðə sˈeɪm pˈiːs ʌv mjˈuːzɪk. fɹʌm aʊtsˈaɪd, ðeɪ lˈʊk ðə sˈeɪm.

lines.text: But for one, the ego is being confirmed and enlarged. For the other, it is being loosened. The direction is opposite.
lines.ph: bˌʌt fɔːɹwˈʌn, ðɪ ˈiːɡoʊ ɪz bˌiːɪŋ kənfˈɜːmd ænd ɛnlˈɑːɹdʒd. fɚðɪ ˈʌðɚ, ɪɾ ɪz bˌiːɪŋ lˈuːsənd. ðə dᵻɹˈɛkʃən ɪz ˈɑːpəzˌɪt.

lines.text: Grief is like that too. Egoic grief mourns a lost possession; tenderness honours what helped dissolve the ego.
lines.ph: ɡɹˈiːf ɪz lˈaɪk ðæt tˈuː. iːɡˈoʊɪk ɡɹˈiːf mˈoːɹnz ɐ lˈɔst pəzˈɛʃən; tˈɛndɚnəs ˈɑːnɚz wʌt hˈɛlpt dɪsˈɑːlv ðɪ ˈiːɡoʊ.

lines.text: And joy, it says, can sit beside physical pain.
lines.ph: ænd dʒˈɔɪ, ɪt sˈɛz, kæn sˈɪt bᵻsˌaɪd fˈɪzɪkəl pˈeɪn.

lines.text: In ethics, mercy treats the symptom; compassion goes to the root.
lines.ph: ɪn ˈɛθɪks, mˈɜːsi tɹˈiːts ðə sˈɪmptəm; kəmpˈæʃən ɡoʊz tə ðə ɹˈuːt.

lines.text: The line of moral concern is sentience. An animal's suffering counts as much as a human's bodily pain.
lines.ph: ðə lˈaɪn ʌv mˈɔːɹəl kənsˈɜːn ɪz sˈɛnʃəns. ɐn ˈænɪməlz sˈʌfɚɹɪŋ kˈaʊnts æz mˈʌtʃ æz ɐ hjˈuːmənz bˈɑːdili pˈeɪn.

lines.text: The framework defines its highest values by what they are not.
lines.ph: ðə fɹˈeɪmwɜːk dᵻfˈaɪnz ɪts hˈaɪɪst vˈæljuːz baɪ wʌt ðeɪ ɑːɹ nˈɑːt.

lines.text: Truth is what is not false. Beauty is what is not ugly. And Shiva, the auspicious, is whatever serves the ego's dissolution.
lines.ph: tɹˈuːθ ɪz wʌt ɪz nˌɑːt fˈɔls. bjˈuːɾi ɪz wʌt ɪz nˌɑːt ˈʌɡli. ˈænd ʃˈɪvə, ðɪ ɔːspˈɪʃəs, ɪz wʌtˈɛvɚ sˈɜːvz ðɪ ˈiːɡoʊz dˌɪsəlˈuːʃən.

lines.text: Satyam, Shivam, Sundaram: three names for one principle.
lines.ph: sˈʌtjəm, ʃˈɪvəm, sˈʊndəɹəm: θɹˈiː nˈeɪmz fɔːɹ wˈʌn pɹˈɪnsɪpəl.

lines.text: Great art, too, is made in the ego's absence. The artist disappears, and returns, and disappears again.
lines.ph: ɡɹˈeɪt ˈɑːɹt, tˈuː, ɪz mˌeɪd ɪnðɪ ˈiːɡoʊz ˈæbsəns. ðɪ ˈɑːɹɾɪst dˌɪsɐpˈɪɹz, ænd ɹᵻtˈɜːnz, ænd dˌɪsɐpˈɪɹz ɐɡˈɛn.

lines.text: Creativity, it says, is creating without a creator.
lines.ph: kɹiːˌeɪtˈɪvᵻɾi, ɪt sˈɛz, ɪz kɹiːˈeɪɾɪŋ wɪðˌaʊt ɐ kɹiːˈeɪɾɚ.

lines.text: Because the ego is both contestant and referee, it cannot judge its own progress. An outside reference is needed: a teacher, a text, a tradition.
lines.ph: bɪkˈʌz ðɪ ˈiːɡoʊ ɪz bˈoʊθ kəntˈɛstənt ænd ɹˌɛfɚɹˈiː, ɪt kænˈɑːt dʒˈʌdʒ ɪts ˈoʊn pɹˈɑːɡɹɛs. ɐn aʊtsˈaɪd ɹˈɛfɹəns ɪz nˈiːdᵻd: ɐ tˈiːtʃɚ, ɐ tˈɛkst, ɐ tɹɐdˈɪʃən.

lines.text: The teacher is like the sun, shining on everyone without bias. Who responds depends on who is ready to be disturbed.
lines.ph: ðə tˈiːtʃɚɹ ɪz lˈaɪk ðə sˈʌn, ʃˈaɪnɪŋ ˌɔn ˈɛvɹɪwˌʌn wɪðˌaʊt bˈaɪəs. hˌuː ɹᵻspˈɑːndz dᵻpˈɛndz ˌɔn hˌuː ɪz ɹˈɛdi təbi dɪstˈɜːbd.

lines.text: The teacher is a mirror and a catalyst. He does not hand out liberation; he helps you see yourself more honestly.
lines.ph: ðə tˈiːtʃɚɹ ɪz ɐ mˈɪɹɚ ænd ɐ kˈæɾɐlˌɪst. hiː dʌznˌɑːt hˈænd ˈaʊt lˌɪbɚɹˈeɪʃən; hiː hˈɛlps juː sˈiː joːɹsˈɛlf mˈoːɹ ˈɑːnɪstli.

lines.text: Trust is given a little at a time, and withdrawn if it is not helping.
lines.ph: tɹˈʌst ɪz ɡˈɪvən ɐ lˈɪɾəl æɾə tˈaɪm, ænd wɪθdɹˈɔːn ɪf ɪɾ ɪz nˌɑːt hˈɛlpɪŋ.

lines.text: The relationship is complete when it is no longer needed, as with Krishna and Arjuna in the Gita.
lines.ph: ðə ɹᵻlˈeɪʃənʃˌɪp ɪz kəmplˈiːt wɛn ɪɾ ɪz nˌoʊ lˈɑːŋɡɚ nˈiːdᵻd, æz wˈɪð kɹˈɪʃnə ˈænd ˈɑːɹdʒʊnə ɪnðˈə ɡˈiːtɑː.

lines.text: The framework sets itself against many traditions.
lines.ph: ðə fɹˈeɪmwɜːk sˈɛts ɪtsˈɛlf ɐɡˈɛnst mˈɛni tɹɐdˈɪʃənz.

lines.text: With Shankara's Advaita it shares the method of negation, but it rejects the witness, the sakshi, as the ego's last refuge.
lines.ph: wˈɪð ʃˈʌŋkəɹəz ədvˈaɪtə ɪt ʃˈɛɹz ðə mˈɛθəd ʌv nᵻɡˈeɪʃən, bˌʌt ɪt ɹᵻdʒˈɛkts ðə wˈɪtnəs, ðˈə sˈɑːkʃi, æz ðɪ ˈiːɡoʊz lˈæst ɹˈɛfjuːdʒ.

lines.text: With Nagarjuna it shares the method of negation, but it places the root of the problem in the body, not in thought.
lines.ph: wˈɪð nɑːɡˈɑːɹdʒʊnə ɪt ʃˈɛɹz ðə mˈɛθəd ʌv nᵻɡˈeɪʃən, bˌʌt ɪt plˈeɪsᵻz ðə ɹˈuːt ʌvðə pɹˈɑːbləm ɪnðə bˈɑːdi, nˌɑːt ɪn θˈɔːt.

lines.text: Schopenhauer is its closest Western parallel. But Jung's individuation, it says, is the most sophisticated form of ego fattening, and the Stoic sage is an ego polished, not dissolved.
lines.ph: ʃˈoʊpənhaʊɚ ɪz ɪts klˈoʊsɪst wˈɛstɚn pˈæɹəlˌɛl. bˈʌt jˈʊŋz ˌɪndᵻvˌɪdʒuːˈeɪʃən, ɪt sˈɛz, ɪz ðə mˈoʊst səfˈɪstᵻkˌeɪɾᵻd fˈɔːɹm ʌv ˈiːɡoʊ fˈæʔn̩ɪŋ, ænd ðə stˈoʊɪk sˈeɪdʒ ɪz ɐn ˈiːɡoʊ pˈɑːlɪʃt, nˌɑːt dɪsˈɑːlvd.

lines.text: Neo-Advaita's claim that we are already enlightened is called the ego's cleverest evasion.
lines.ph: nˈiːoʊɐdvˈeɪɾəz klˈeɪm ðæt wiː ɑːɹ ɔːlɹˌɛdi ɛnlˈaɪʔn̩d ɪz kˈɔːld ðɪ ˈiːɡoʊz klˈɛvɚɹɪst ɪvˈeɪʒən.

lines.text: For the framework, enlightenment as a final state is impossible. Liberation is a direction: a journey without a destination.
lines.ph: fɚðə fɹˈeɪmwɜːk, ɛnlˈaɪʔn̩mənt æz ɐ fˈaɪnəl stˈeɪt ɪz ɪmpˈɑːsᵻbəl. lˌɪbɚɹˈeɪʃən ɪz ɐ dᵻɹˈɛkʃən: ɐ dʒˈɜːni wɪðˌaʊt ɐ dˌɛstɪnˈeɪʃən.

lines.text: Last, a warning for the rationalist, who questions religion, tradition and authority.
lines.ph: lˈæst, ɐ wˈɔːɹnɪŋ fɚðə ɹˈæʃənəlˌɪst, hˌuː kwˈɛstʃənz ɹᵻlˈɪdʒən, tɹɐdˈɪʃən ænd ɐθˈɔːɹɪɾi.

lines.text: He questions everything, except the one who is questioning.
lines.ph: hiː kwˈɛstʃənz ˈɛvɹɪθˌɪŋ, ɛksˈɛpt ðə wˈʌn hˌuː ɪz kwˈɛstʃənɪŋ.

lines.text: The ego is the first superstition. It challenges everything, except itself.
lines.ph: ðɪ ˈiːɡoʊ ɪz ðə fˈɜːst sˈuːpɚstˈɪʃən. ɪt tʃˈælɪndʒᵻz ˈɛvɹɪθˌɪŋ, ɛksˈɛpt ɪtsˈɛlf.

lines.text: The framework's promise is modest. No faith, no technique, no renunciation; only honest self-observation.
lines.ph: ðə fɹˈeɪmwɜːks pɹˈɑːmɪs ɪz mˈɑːdɪst. nˈoʊ fˈeɪθ, nˈoʊ tɛknˈiːk, nˈoʊ ɹᵻnˌʌnsɪˈeɪʃən; ˈoʊnli ˈɑːnɪst sˈɛlfɑːbzɚvˈeɪʃən.

lines.text: Each time you catch the ego at work, it weakens, by a fraction.
lines.ph: ˈiːtʃ tˈaɪm juː kˈætʃ ðɪ ˈiːɡoʊ æt wˈɜːk, ɪt wˈiːkənz, baɪ ɐ fɹˈækʃən.

lines.text: And in that moment of catching, the one who was imprisoned is briefly absent. That, it says, is enough.
lines.ph: ænd ɪn ðæt mˈoʊmənt ʌv kˈætʃɪŋ, ðə wˈʌn hˌuː wʌz ɪmpɹˈɪzənd ɪz bɹˈiːfli ˈæbsənt. ðˈæt, ɪt sˈɛz, ɪz ɪnˈʌf.
